summary: Sydney Dental Veneers shows clear starting prices, media logos and online booking.

findings.problem: The counters show 100,000+ patients and 23,000+ veneers, then later 70+ patients, 3+ five-star reviews and 302+ years of experience.
findings.cost: A patient who sees 302 years of experience or 3 reviews doubts every number on the page.
findings.fix: One verified set of numbers, shown correctly.

findings.problem: The page repeatedly describes in-house ceramic labs, but the footer says Our restorations are crafted by our partner lab.
findings.cost: A claim that contradicts itself raises doubts about everything else you say about quality.
findings.fix: One clear, accurate statement about where veneers are made.

findings.problem: Payment prices conflict: $57 a week for porcelain in the FAQ, from $30 a week for Invisalign elsewhere, and composite shows no price in one place but from $700 per tooth in another.
findings.cost: Price confusion is the main reason patients delay booking and compare other clinics.
findings.fix: One price page with clear starting prices for every treatment.

findings.problem: The Explore Treatment Results section shows filter labels but no visible before and after images, and there are no written patient testimonials. Services links to #, and there is no contact form or chat.
findings.cost: Veneer patients decide on visible results. Without them or a quick way to ask a question, many leave.
findings.fix: A working results gallery, written reviews and a short contact form.

redesign: A proof first homepage with accurate numbers, real before and after cases and your prices beside every booking button.
One price page and one clear statement about your lab.
